name: maiboli
description: Speak in your mother tongue — Hindi, Marathi, Spanish, and 55+ more languages — and get English text at your cursor. Works in code files, terminals, and AI chat boxes.

maiboli.provider.description: Which speech engine to use. 'whisper' = OpenAI (any of 55+ languages -> English). 'sarvam' = Sarvam AI (best for Indian languages and Hinglish).

maiboli.openaiApiKey.description: Your OpenAI API key (used when provider = whisper).

maiboli.sarvamApiKey.description: Your Sarvam API key (used when provider = sarvam).

maiboli.recorder.description: Which tool records your mic. 'sox' is simplest and works on Mac + Windows. 'ffmpeg' is Mac-only.

maiboli.recorderPath.description: Optional: full path to sox/ffmpeg if VS Code can't find it (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/sox or C:\Program Files (x86)\sox-14-4-2\sox.exe).
